items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: another, one named Luther, from Little Rock, that did all of the setting up and taking down to the band, and driving the bus

ctx.x: Well, you would have a, you'd have a valet?

We had two. We had a fellow that drove the bus, Wilbur Usand, and another, one named Luther, from Little Rock, that did all of the setting up and taking down to the band, and driving the bus, and different things like that.
Well, would they be responsible if something got misplaced?
